text:
PARIS — The limited curfew conditions set up for France's capital in the wake of last weekend's violent protests will continue on Tuesday evening and may stay in place for as long as deemed necessary, wrote the Paris police department on X on Tuesday.
The curfew lasts from 11 p.m. (2100 GMT) until 6 a.m. (0400 GMT) local time, and mainly covers the Republique and Halles areas of the capital.
